args.sql:
WITH EquipmentWithRenewables AS (
    SELECT 
        tsw.thermaleqref AS equipment_code
    FROM 
        "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" tsw
    WHERE 
        tsw.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w' IS NOT NULL 
        OR tsw.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w' IS NOT NULL
),
EquipmentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT ewr.equipment_code) AS equipment_count
    FROM 
        Location l
    LEFT JOIN 
        EquipmentWithRenewables ewr ON l.loceqref = ewr.equipment_code
    GROUP BY 
        l.locationregistry
),
RenewableReliance AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry, 
        SUM(
            (
                tsw.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w'::float + 
                tsw.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w'::float
            ) * 
            CASE 
                WHEN pb.powersource ILIKE '%solar%' THEN 1 
                WHEN pb.powersource ILIKE '%wind%' THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS total_renewable_power
    FROM 
        Location l
    JOIN 
        EquipmentWithRenewables ewr ON l.loceqref = ewr.equipment_code
    LEFT JOIN 
        PowerBattery pb ON ewr.equipment_code = pb.pwrbatteqref
    LEFT JOIN 
        "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" tsw ON ewr.equipment_code = tsw.thermaleqref
    GROUP BY 
        l.locationregistry
),
Classification AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry, 
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT e.equipmenttype, 
            ', ' 
            ORDER BY 
                e.equipmenttype
        ) AS classification
    FROM 
        Location l
    JOIN 
        Equipment e ON l.loceqref = e.equipmentcode
    GROUP BY 
        l.locationregistry
)
SELECT 
    l.locationtype, 
    l.stationname, 
    ec.equipment_count, 
    rr.total_renewable_power, 
    c.classification
FROM 
    Location l
LEFT JOIN 
    EquipmentCount ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    RenewableReliance rr ON l.locationregistry = rr.locationregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    Classification c ON l.locationregistry = c.locationregistry
ORDER BY 
    l.stationname;
